name: Blue Spark: Spark Academy
source:
Clara joins an academy for those with special powers known as the Spark. However, little did she anticipate that she would cross paths with an old love.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
克拉拉进入了一所专为拥有“火花”异能之人设立的学院。然而她万万没有料到，自己竟会在这里与昔日旧爱再度重逢。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
